author: ahan94
quote: Honestly, GTA 6 feels more like a downgrade than an actual improvement over GTA 5. Despite the impressive graphics and visual details, the gameplay and main character (MC) story leave a lot to be desired. My biggest disappointment is the protagonist's storyline. GTA 5 gave us three playable protagonists with completely different personalities, backgrounds, and storylines. Their interactions, character development, and ability to switch between them made the experience incredibly entertaining. GTA 6, on the other hand, feels like it's taking a step backward in terms of storytelling. The MC story doesn't seem nearly as compelling or exciting as what GTA 5 delivered. Better graphics and a bigger world mean very little if the characters and storyline fail to capture the same excitement.Rockstar, we wanted an evolution of GTA 5, not a downgrade disguised with better **** this point, GTA 5 still sets a higher standard for protagonist storytelling and overall gameplay experience.
